verdict.rationale: Consent capture and enforcement is a fair question for a Composable CDP and event-collection platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents consent categories, opt-out handling, or automatic suppression of opted-out users at destinations. The closest items are general data-governance features: access and usage rules, data contracts, and HIPAA-compliant syncing. These are adjacent controls, not consent enforcement.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically
